title: Daily dungeons
author: Sefhi
html:
Daily Dungeons are one of the most important activities to do every day, since they are the main source of gear and gear shards for your account progression.

You get 2 free runs per day. Additional runs cost Dawnium Dawnium Description A currency for shop purchases, obtainable through exchanging Luminium at a 1:1 ratio. (2 per day, 100 and 150 respectively), and maxing these out daily is highly recommended if you want to keep your gear up to date.

Rewards

The main rewards from Daily Dungeons are gear, gear shards and Raw Ore Raw Ore Description Use them for gear enhancement. Sources Fantasy LadderGameplayDelegate Tasks . You need 100 shards to craft one gear item of your choice, which can also be traded at the auction house for Dawnium Dawnium Description A currency for shop purchases, obtainable through exchanging Luminium at a 1:1 ratio. .

About gear shards

When new dungeons unlock, previous dungeon shards can only be dismantled, they cannot be sold. Don’t sit on a pile of old shards.

Dungeon nodes and type of rewards:

Gold ChestEpic or Legendary gear + Raw Ore Raw Ore Description Use them for gear enhancement. Sources Fantasy LadderGameplayDelegate Tasks
Silver ChestRare gear + Raw Ore Raw Ore Description Use them for gear enhancement. Sources Fantasy LadderGameplayDelegate Tasks
Empty Node Raw Ore Raw Ore Description Use them for gear enhancement. Sources Fantasy LadderGameplayDelegate Tasks only

Gear quality tiers unlock as you progress through the game:

Legendary and belowAble to obtain from early game
MythicMecha Summit
DivineAquorigin Shrine Hard

Ranking

Your rank (S, A, B, etc.) is determined solely by how far you reach in the dungeon, not by which nodes you pick along the way.

Defeating the boss = S rank

If you defeat the boss, you are guaranteed S rank regardless of your node path. Always aim for that.

Your final rank directly affects the quality of your end chest, which determines:

  • How many shards you receive
  • Your chances of getting a complete gear item drop

So optimizing your path to reach the boss is more important than picking the “safest” nodes or “hardest” nodes.

Boosting drops

There are a few mechanics that can significantly increase your dungeon rewards depending how far into the game you are.

Gear stats

Certain equipped gear pieces can roll one of two special bonuses:

  • 2x Rating Reward Rate: Doubles shards or grants extra gear item chances from the end chest
  • Gear Drop Promotion Rate: Increases chances of upgrading loot quality (Epic → Legendary, Rare → Epic, etc.)

These bonuses are location-specific, so they only activate in the dungeon they are assigned to. I would not worry about these until late game when you can afford to run gear with those stats while still aiming for S rank rewards.

Lucky Statue relic

This relic is available through Grand Treasure Hunt events. It provides 2x rating rewards and gets an extra +20% boost when equipped before entering a dungeon run.

Make sure to equip it before starting your daily runs, you can unequip it afterwards.

Seasonal upgrades

Seasonal upgrades can also grant 2x rating rewards or promotion rate bonuses, stacking on top of your gear bonuses.
